# Zensah

> > Zensah is a premium athletic compression wear brand offering compression socks, sleeves, sports apparel, and recovery products for runners and athletes.

Zensah specializes in compression technology for athletic performance and recovery, with product lines organized by body part (leg sleeves, socks, knee sleeves), gender (men's and women's collections), and special editions (limited-edition designs and themed collections like Marathon Cities and Recovery Collection). The brand focuses on moisture-wicking, supportive athletic apparel for runners and sports enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Compression Socks
- Compression Leg Sleeves
- Compression Wear
- Athletic Recovery
- Running Gear
- Sports Apparel
- Knee & Thigh Sleeves
- Ankle & Plantar Fasciitis Sleeves
- Limited Edition Collections
- Marathon Cities Collection
- Recovery Collection
- Women's Athletic Apparel
- Men's Athletic Apparel
- Moisture-Wicking Technology
- Sports Recovery Products
